stages.text:
Wake up slow
kind: ad
style: Live-action; a still close-up, warm dawn light, quiet natural sound, and a simple cream end card.
For the first three seconds, the camera holds close on the Plaid Mug on the wooden table in the kitchen. Dawn light enters through the window, warming the wooden table. Steam rises from hot brewed coffee in the Plaid Mug, curling above the ceramic rim. The Plaid Mug’s handle and plaid pattern remain visible. There is no music or speech.

Over the next four seconds, Mara’s hand enters beside the Plaid Mug. Mara’s hand closes around the Plaid Mug’s handle. A faint brush against ceramic is audible. The Plaid Mug lifts slowly from the wooden table, with steam still rising. The camera stays still as the Plaid Mug rises toward the upper edge of the frame.

For the final three seconds, the image cuts to a plain cream background. The Cabin Coffee Company logo appears: an irregular burgundy five-point star beside bold, condensed black lettering, CABIN above COFFEE CO. Beneath the Cabin Coffee Company logo, the final words appear: Wake up slow
stages.note: research: Cabin Coffee 10-second ad research. Working identification: Cabin Coffee Company, the Iowa-founded roaster and café franchise. The name is ambiguous: a separate Cabin Coffee operates in Arizona, so confirm the advertiser before using these brand references.

items.prompt: Live-action with warm dawn light, a locked-off camera, quiet natural sound, and a simple cream end card. 0–3 s: Hold a still close-up of the Plaid Mug, a handled plaid-patterned ceramic mug matching the product reference, on a wooden table in a kitchen. Its handle and plaid pattern are clearly visible. Warm dawn light enters through a window and falls across the wood. Hot brewed coffee sits inside; delicate steam curls naturally above the ceramic rim. Keep the kitchen background softly out of focus and the composition uncluttered. Only faint, quiet kitchen room tone is audible. This begins one continuous kitchen shot lasting through 7 seconds. No other text, no cuts during this segment, no camera movement, no music, no speech, no subtitles.
